_comment: Card facts where the official card list disagrees with itself. Each entry is checked against the card image it cites; the importer fails on any disagreement that has no entry here.

EB01-023.note: The OP14-EB04 page lists the SP printing as 8000 power with a 1000 counter; the card prints 6000 and no counter.

ST11-005.note: The ST-11 page gives the first type in Japanese.

ST23-004.note: The ST-31 page lists the reprint as Animal/Straw Hat Crew; the card prints FILM/Supernovas/Straw Hat Crew.
